original.statement: Traefik v3 removes support for the Kubernetes Ingress API Group networking.k8s.io/v1beta1; users must migrate to networking.k8s.io/v1.

decision.reason: [ev-f3d6519c3794] says that in v3, support for the Kubernetes Ingress API group `networking.k8s.io/v1beta1` "has been removed" and tells users to "use the API Group `networking.k8s.io/v1` instead". That supports a gvk subject of networking.k8s.io/v1beta1 Ingress with change type removed, replaced by networking.k8s.io/v1 Ingress. The validators returned inconclusive, which proves nothing either way, so this rests on the prose alone.
